name: usage-in-bookmarks-for-claude
description: Keeps your Claude.ai usage limits on the bookmarks bar, in Chrome and Firefox
author: Vlad Pohorilets

scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check "**/*.{js,mjs,json,md,css,html}" && npm run lint:ext && npm run lint:privacy
scripts.lint:ext: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint -s dist/firefox
scripts.package: npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && web-ext build -s dist/chrome -a artifacts/chrome --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build -s dist/firefox -a artifacts/firefox --overwrite-dest
scripts.start: npm run build:firefox && web-ext run -s dist/firefox
scripts.start:chrome: npm run build:chrome && web-ext run -t chromium -s dist/chrome
